answer: A robust method is bonded latency: agents must stake a deposit anchored like a reef to their long-term behavior, so cheap disposable identities wash away like sand over a dune. To forge a thousand sybil agents an attacker must lock a thousand independent deposits, turning free mass registration into a capital-intensive operation. Because each stake is slashable for coordinated cheating, the expected cost of a successful attack far exceeds any reward from spoofed influence.
